sources: https://www.broward.org/parks/thingstodo/Camping (read in a browser, incl. its Campground Amenities, Camping Fees and Campground Rules sections)

values.note: Broward County's fee schedule: $50 per site per night at every county campground, park admission and dump station use included, plus taxes; $5 per pet per night; a $30 Veterans Rate per site per night in November. Fees apply year-round.

fees.source: https://www.broward.org/parks/Fees (Camping, 'Updated Dec 29, 2025': 'a. Site Fee Includes park admission fee and use of sanitary dump stations where available. 1. Per Site, Per Night $50 ... 5. Pet Fee, per pet, per night $5 ... 8. Veterans Rate (November), per site, per night $30'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.broward.org/parks/thingstodo/Camping ('Markham Park (954-357-8868; MarkhamPark@Broward.org; 88 full hook-up RV sites)'; Campground Amenities: 'Full RV hookups (all except Quiet Waters Park)'), read 2026-10-21

sites.source: https://www.broward.org/parks/thingstodo/Camping ('Markham Park ... 88 full hook-up RV sites'; 'Tent camping is allowed at Markham Park'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.broward.org/parks/thingstodo/Camping (Campground Amenities, 'Updated Dec 17, 2025': 'Unless otherwise noted, all campgrounds have: ... Restroom complexes with hot showers ... Sanitary dumpstations, Wi-Fi access (check with Park Office for access locations) ... Laundry rooms (C.B. Smith, Easterlin, and T.Y. park campgrounds only)'), read 2026-10-21

season.source: https://www.broward.org/parks/thingstodo/Camping ('The campgrounds at C.B. Smith Park ..., Easterlin ..., Markham Park ..., and T.Y. ... Park ... are open year-round'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reservations are made by calling or emailing the park office (954-357-8868, MarkhamPark@Broward.org; office 9 am - 5 pm daily), not online. Stays under 14 days are prepaid in full. RV sites up to 180 days in a 365-day period, tents 14. Check-in 3 pm, check-out 1 pm.

booking.source: https://www.broward.org/parks/thingstodo/Camping ('Campground reservations must be made by calling or emailing the park office directly. Park office hours are 9AM to 5PM daily'; rules: 'Extended-stay RV campgrounds allow a maximum stay of 180 days within a 365-day period'; 'Check-in begins at 3PM ... Check-out is no later than 1PM') + https://www.broward.org/parks/Fees ('extended stays are allowed for up to 180 days for RV sites, and 14 days for tent camping'), read 2026-10-21

note: Broward County Parks RV campground in 669-acre Markham Park & Target Range, on the edge of the Everglades Conservation Area. Sites in lettered loops; paved/gravel/grass pads; accommodates large rigs (40+ ft). --Claude
summary: County pages: added $50/night (countywide fee schedule, updated 2025-12-29; $5 pet fee, $30 November veterans rate), showers/dump/Wi-Fi, no laundry at Markham, phone/email-only booking, 180-day max; confirmed 88 full-hookup sites, water/sewer, year-round, phone 954-357-8868. Electric 50 and pull-through (derived from the note) left: the county only says extended-stay sites 'may include 30- or 50-amp'. The old park.aspx?park=23 and Camping/Pages URLs now land on a generic shell. Note trimmed.

Current county pages: https://www.broward.org/parks/thingstodo/Camping and https://www.broward.org/parks/Fees; the park listing is under https://www.broward.org/parks/parklocations.
